name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fix: the same real show, synced from two different federated servers, ended up with two full parallel season/episode trees under the one (correctly deduped) series - every episode of the show showing up twice. Series and movies dedup across servers by provider id (IMDb/TMDb/TVDB), but seasons and episodes never had a merge step of their own - each was always keyed by (server, remote id), so a second server providing the same show just added a sibling season and a full second set of episodes rather than being recognized as the same content. Seasons now merge by (series key, season number) and episodes by (season key, episode number) - scoped to an already-confirmed matching series/season, not an independent provider-id lookup, so this carries none of the cross-show collision risk that keeps episode matching itself off provider ids directly. A server no longer providing its copy still leaves the other server's copy intact, same as any other multi-source federated item. 268 tests, all green.
